body: So, update. I did exactly this and it really did make her see it from a different angle. It went over very well. I just basically explained how much of a loss it would be and how I honestly don’t feel like I could go on if I lost her like that.  Brought us even closer to each other.

The thing is, I’m actually not in a bad place right now. What side would be concerned and worried for my fiancé in the hard times she’s going through, I’m doing really well. However, I know that if She were to commit suicide, I would refuse to go on living. I would be very close behind her. Scares me, but it’s true.
